title: 第25章 混沌空间第四层复制万物第26章 陛下还是反了吗
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
治疗完唐妙衣，叶凡从房间出来。
萧雅妃跟着走出来：“小弟！你从哪儿学的医术？”
“你明明是天脉者，不能修武的！”
“现在你不但可以修武，医术居然比赛华佗还要高？”
“小弟，这段时间在你身上到底发生了什么？”
月光下一双美眸全是疑惑！
她有些看不懂了！
“明明才几个月啊！去年过年的时候，你还是……”
萧雅妃停顿，没有继续说下去，担心自己的话伤到叶凡。
叶凡却一笑，接过萧雅妃的话：“我还是大夏第一废物纨绔！”
萧雅妃摇头：“小弟，你不是废物！”
“可是，这才过去几个月，你怎么就让我看不透了？”
她盯着叶凡。
叶凡心中长叹！
对于萧雅妃来说是几个月，可是对他来说，是两世为人啊！
沉默了许久，叶凡才开口：“雅妃姐，我做了一个梦，去了一个很远很远的地方，是那里让我发生了改变！”
“很远的地方？”
“对，很远的地方！”
萧雅妃看着叶凡的眼神，有些心疼，那是一股饱经沧桑的感觉。
她上前摸了一下叶凡的脸颊：“那以后有机会，你带我去好不好？”

叶凡一愣。
旋即点了点头：“好！如果可能，我带你去！”
“对了雅妃姐，你这里有丹药吗？”
萧雅妃很聪明：“你要修炼？好！你要多少丹药？”
叶凡思索几秒钟，发现他对武者还不是很熟悉：“我现在是一阶武师，如果突破的话，需要多少丹药？”
“一般一阶武师，五十颗人级下品丹药足够突破一个小境界！”萧雅妃微微一笑。
丹药等级，从高到低：天、地、玄、黄、人。
一共五个等级。
分为上中下三品。
还有一种失败的丹药，次品。
五十颗人级下品丹药，她现在就能拿出来，刚准备让人去拿丹药！
“呃……应该不够……”
叶凡摇了摇头。
“怎么？”
“因为我有四条武脉，应该需要四倍的丹药吧？”
此话一出！
萧雅妃愣在原地，美眸圆瞪，整个人都在颤抖，呼吸也变得急促，俏脸更是通红无比！
“小凡，你觉醒了四条武脉？怎么可能！”
叶凡肯定的说道：“雅妃姐，是真的。”
萧雅妃俏脸变得严肃无比，上前一把扣住叶凡的手腕。

一股温和的内力，顺势进入叶凡的体内！
除了任督二脉，果然还有另外两条武脉！
“嘶！小弟，你真的觉醒四条武脉了？”萧雅妃倒吸一口凉气。
美眸中满是惊喜！
她直接跳起来！
content_en:
After treating Tang Miaoyi, Ye Fan came out of the room.
Xiao Yafei followed and walked out: "Little brother! Where did you learn medical skills?"
"You are obviously a Tianmai practitioner and cannot practice martial arts!"
"Now you can not only practice martial arts, but your medical skills are even better than those of Hua Tuo?"
"Brother, what happened to you during this time?"
A pair of beautiful eyes under the moonlight are full of doubts!
She can't understand it!
"It's only been a few months! Last year during the Chinese New Year, you were still..."
Xiao Yafei paused and did not continue speaking, worried that her words would hurt Mark.
Ye Fan smiled and took over Xiao Yafei's words: "I am still the number one loser in Daxia!"
Xiao Yafei shook her head: "Little brother, you are not a waste!"
"But, it's only been a few months, why can't you let me see through it?"
She stared at Mark.
Ye Fan sighed in his heart!
For Xiao Yafei, it was a few months, but to him, it was two lifetimes!
After being silent for a long time, Ye Fan finally spoke: "Sister Yafei, I had a dream and went to a place far, far away. It was there that changed me!"
"Far away?"
"Yes, very far away!"
Xiao Yafei looked at Mark Ye with a somewhat distressed look, a feeling that had gone through many vicissitudes of life.
She stepped forward and touched Mark's cheek: "Then if you have a chance in the future, can you take me there?"
Ye Fan was stunned.
He nodded immediately: "Okay! If possible, I will take you there!"
"By the way, Sister Yafei, do you have any elixirs here?"
Xiao Yafei is very smart: "You want to practice? OK! How many pills do you want?"
Ye Fan thought for a few seconds and found that he was not very familiar with warriors: "I am now a first-level warrior. How many pills will I need if I break through?"
"For an average first-level martial artist, fifty low-level human-level elixirs are enough to break through a small realm!" Xiao Yafei smiled slightly.
The levels of elixirs, from high to low: Heaven, Earth, Xuan, Huang, and Human.
There are five levels in total.
Divided into upper, middle and lower grades.
There is also a failed elixir, a defective product.
She can take out fifty low-grade human-level elixirs right now, and is just about to ask someone to get the elixirs!
"Uh... it shouldn't be enough..."
Ye Fan shook his head.
"What?"
"Because I have four martial veins, I should need four times the amount of pills, right?"
As soon as these words came out!
Xiao Yafei froze on the spot, her beautiful eyes widened, her whole body was trembling, her breathing became rapid, and her pretty face was extremely red!
"Xiaofan, have you awakened four martial arteries? How is that possible!"
Ye Fan said with certainty: "Sister Yafei, it's true."
Xiao Yafei's pretty face became extremely serious, and she stepped forward and grabbed Ye Fan's wrist.
A gentle internal force entered Ye Fan's body!
In addition to Ren and Du's second line, there are indeed two other martial art lines!
"Hiss! Little brother, have you really awakened the four martial arteries?" Xiao Yafei took a breath of cold air.
Beautiful eyes full of surprises!
She jumped right up!
